notes.title: Give old sports facilities a second life! Sports: Renovations announced
notes.content:
What happens when a sports game meets a house renovator? A game where you renovate old sports facilities! 

Restore the glory of sports in a relaxing renovator sim, made by Goat Gamez, a studio founded by Movie Games and Robert Lewandowski!

Wishlist the game now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

How do you save your beloved team’s court from being torn down by a real estate developer? You do what you do best – renovate dilapidated sports facilities to collect the money you need to help out.

Restore gyms, courts, pools and pitches to their former glory, upgrade your tools and expand your headquarters. Collect trophies and mementoes during your renovation missions and display them proudly in a special room for everyone to see.

FEATURES:

Two game modes: Campaign with a predefined number of levels and storyline.
Buy new tools and upgrade the equipment you already own.
Earn money on your renovation jobs and use it to expand your own base of operations – each room unlocked will add some perks and some of the rooms come with a side mission.
Buy cosmetic items you can place around your office.
Trophy room where the player sees various memorabilia collected during renovation missions.

Are you ready to give sports facilities a second chance?

notes.title: The patch is here!
The patch is here!
The patch is coming!
You played, we collected your feedback! What are the results?
notes.content:
Hello, Mythbusters!

The playtests ended some time ago and we’ve been collecting your feedback! Thank you so much for your participation and engagement – all your remarks and suggestions are extremely valuable to us. So, what are the results?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024330/d6b69f9130a3a8268b7f89be0ea76d82715f02f9.png

A lot of you took part in the playtest, we were astounded! The overall score is 4 out of 5 stars, or 80%, or 8/10 if you prefer these scoring systems. Most of you rated the gameplay, graphics and music 4/5, and the performance and atmosphere 5/5. That’s great results!


What you seem to have liked most are the blueprint minigames, exploring the mechanics and tools at your disposal, the detailed interior of the workshop, and so on. 
You liked the fact that you are involved in the myth from beginning to end, starting with the concept, creating all the necessary parts and ending with testing the myth out and creating an episode. 
You were also thrilled with the customization elements, where you could use the parts you chose for the construction of tools and elements.


What did you think could be improved? You had some suggestions regarding for example the tutorial and camera control, and we’ve jotted down all of them. They were all valid notes!

All in all, you really enjoyed the spirit of MythBusters in our game. You liked the atmosphere inside the workshop and being creatively engaged in all stages of the myth testing. You noted the realism of items and tools, and the details in the shop. You’d like background music to be added and to limit the number of screws and nails you need to hammer in 😁

Thank you so much for your participation and your feedback, none of it would be possible without you! Wishlist the full game, if you haven’t already, and…

See ya later!

notes.title: Status Update – What are we working on?
notes.content:
Hello, Mythbusters!

We’re sure you are curious about what we’re doing now, so we bring you some more news from the first lines. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024330/aa6eb2d4619a8504298a30db84f3def4e6e096af.jpg

We’re now working on improving the overall clarity of the game. We’re adjusting the UI so it is easier to understand. We want you to navigate it with more ease and we want it to look neat. We’re also adding the checklist mechanic, so while playing you’ll be able to track your progress step by step and see what’s been done and what more remains until the myth is completed. 

What’s more, we’re correcting markers and texts, and we’re fixing some bugs we’ve caught. Overall, the work is ongoing and we are polishing the game with fervour! 

Stay tuned for more news. Wishlist the game if you haven’t already, it really helps us out! See ya!
